title: Calle Libre (Free Style)
style: latin hip hop, nicaraguan freestyle rap, reggaeton dembow undercurrent, acoustic nylon guitar, congas and timbales, warm bass guitar, conscious lyricism, 95 BPM, dusty jazz keys, vinyl crackle, golden age boom bap drums, no swearing, spanish english code switch
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar, conga roll]
Rafa en la casa
Desde San Juan del Sur, free style
Numero cuatro en la lista — listen

[Verse 1 - Spanish]
Desde Nicaragua hasta el VDS Mansion
Free style en el micro, sin condicion
Corey me firmo, ahora soy artista
DistroKid en el feed, somos una lista
Michelle con la pala, kitchen game pesado
Bongo en el tambor, internacional probado
Zynrose en la nube, petalos brillando
Y yo aqui en la calle, libre rapeando

[Pre-Chorus - English]
Free style, free man
Wrote my name with my own hand
Number four on the team
Living out the Sandbox dream

[Chorus]
Calle libre, libre soy
From the streets to where I'm going, where I'm going I'm going to go
Free style, free flow
Rafa got the heart and Rafa got the soul
Calle libre, libre soy
Nicaragua to the world — Hard core boy

[Verse 2 - Spanglish]
Grew up where the ocean meets the road
Learned to flow before I learned the code
Corey heard me on the corner spitting hot
Said "firma aqui, you got the spot"
Ahora estoy con la familia entera
Michelle, Bongo, Zynrose, la bandera
Five artists, one mansion, one feed
Three-three-six — that's all we need

[Pre-Chorus]
Free style, free man
Wrote my name with my own hand
Number four on the team
Living out the Sandbox dream

[Chorus]
Calle libre, libre soy
From the streets to where I'm going, where I'm going I'm going to go
Free style, free flow
Rafa got the heart and Rafa got the soul
Calle libre, libre soy
Nicaragua to the world — Hard core boy

[Bridge - guitar solo over conga]
(let the nylon strings talk)

[Outro - spoken Spanish]
Gracias Corey, gracias familia
San Juan del Sur al VDS Mansion
Calle libre por siempre…
